name: Parameter-level Geometry-Appearance Decoupling
definition: A mechanism that restricts the parameter groups affected by each loss term, yielding optimization-level geometry–appearance decoupling. Specifically, VTC acts only on the appearance parameters.
summary: Parameter-level Geometry-Appearance Decoupling isolates optimization by routing gradients to specific parameter groups, preventing photometric errors from corrupting geometry without altering the Gaussian representation.
